brief.headline: Push to match Sayaji's ₹66.48/KG price — you're already paying 13.6% less to them for the same Dextrose

priceAsk.summary: Ask them to match ₹66.48/KG, the price Sayaji Industries gives us today
priceAsk.basis: We pay them ₹75.51/KG but Sayaji charges ₹66.48/KG for identical Dextrose Anhydrous IP — a 13.6% gap. The open market ask for Anhydrous Dextrose IP sits at ₹60–81/kg (typically ₹66–73/kg), so our target sits right in the normal band and is already a price we pay elsewhere.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Keep 30 Days After Receipt — no reason to tighten terms here

brief.financialLeverage: They're solid but small potatoes for them — we're just 0.12% of their ₹514.62 Cr in sales. They keep about ₹4 of every ₹100 they sell (3.7%) and their health score is middling (C, 58/100), so they're stable but not flush. The good news: they're growing fast (21.4% per year), so they want orders. Bundle a longer commitment or more volume and trade that for the price cut — alone, ₹59.65 L won't move them much.

evidence.point: We pay them ₹75.51/KG but Sayaji gives us ₹66.48/KG for the same material
Their open-market asking price for Anhydrous Dextrose IP is ₹60–81/kg, typically ₹66–73/kg — our target sits in that normal range
We are a tiny customer — 0.12% of everything they sell
They're growing sales fast and want new orders
They keep a slim profit — about ₹4 of every ₹100

alternates.name: Gulshan Polyols Ltd
alternates.why: Listed starch & polyol maker (₹2359.06 Cr revenue, health B 62/100) — established dextrose supplier, a drop-in alternate to Sayaji

alternates.name: Sanstar Ltd
alternates.why: Recently-listed maize-derivatives specialist (₹821.13 Cr revenue, health C 53/100) making starch and dextrose with growing capacity

alternates.name: Tirupati Starch & Chemicals Ltd
alternates.why: Listed Indore maize wet-miller (₹365.39 Cr revenue) making Dextrose ANHYDROUS IV-fluid grade — exact form match; confirm IP monograph CoA before switching (health D 27/100, so check closely)

risks: You're only 0.12% of their business, so on your own you have little pull — bundle more volume or a multi-year commitment to make the ask stick
Their health score is middling (C, 58/100) — not distressed, but not rich either, so a big cut without a volume sweetener may not fly
Sayaji is already giving us the better price — if Universal won't move, shift more volume to Sayaji and qualify one of the alternates as a third source
Tirupati's health is weak (D, 27/100) — audit them carefully before adding as a backup
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: Sayaji is charging us ₹66.48 per kilo for the same Dextrose you supply at ₹75.51 — we'd like to align your price with theirs and, in return, we can talk about a longer commitment or more volume.
